sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 28 points from 12 games, host Bilston Town on Saturday at 15:00. This is a clash between the division's top two sides, with second-placed Bilston Town just two points behind on 26 points. Sandbach arrive in excellent form with five consecutive league wins before a draw, while Bilston have won their last five league matches, making this a compelling contest between the division's in-form sides.
divisionWide: Stafford Town (3rd, 24 pts) travel to Brereton Social in a fixture that could consolidate their position in the title hunt, though they come off a recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth (4th, 23 pts) face Barnton (6th, 21 pts) in a match between two sides with strong recent form—Bridgnorth have won three of their last six, while Barnton have won four of their last six. Wolverhampton Casuals (5th, 22 pts) host Telford Town (18th, 7 pts), a significant gap between a high-flying side and one struggling near the bottom. Eccleshall (7th, 19 pts) host Crewe in a mid-table encounter. New Mills (8th, 18 pts) visit Alsager Town (20th, 4 pts), who have lost their last six league matches consecutively. Allscott Heath (9th, 17 pts) face Foley Meir (13th, 12 pts), with Allscott in good recent form after four consecutive wins. Shawbury United (11th, 13 pts) host Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th, 11 pts) in a lower-mid-table clash. Wednesfield Community (10th, 14 pts) travel to Market Drayton Town (12th, 13 pts). Finally, Widnes Town (19th, 6 pts) host Dawley Town (15th, 12 pts), a fixture between two struggling sides near the bottom of the table.
